when: before any Stage-B readout (only training-progress log lines had been seen) and before any Stage-C explanation evaluation
why: Stage D is the no-increment convergence branch; its slices must be fixed before the C1-GINE error structure is inspected in this round
source: read-only historical predictions of the sprint round (L_lipophilicity, G0_lipophilicity) and the frozen path3 cache

slices.name: atom_count_quartile
slices.definition: quartiles of the heavy-atom count of the Valid molecules, equal-count bins
slices.why: size is the first dimension the C1 readout compresses

slices.name: paths3_quartile
slices.definition: quartiles of the number of three-bond paths of the molecule (the new structural object), equal-count bins
slices.why: the composition route can only matter where the object exists in quantity

slices.name: ring_atom_fraction_bin
slices.definition: fraction of ring atoms, binned as {0, (0,0.3], (0.3,0.6], (0.6,1]}
slices.why: the fixed-topology-block family already failed here; a gap concentrated in ring-rich molecules would say the gap is topological, not compositional

slices.name: c1_error_decile
slices.definition: deciles of |C1 residual| on Valid, equal-count bins
slices.why: distinguishes 'GINE is uniformly better' from 'GINE only fixes the 10% worst molecules'

statistic: per-slice RMSE of the read-only C1 and GINE predictions, the gap, and a 2000-draw paired molecule bootstrap CI of that gap
test_policy: Valid only for the decision; the same table is produced once for Development Test as a read-once report column
